narrative.overview: OrbityLabs is a tactile editorial future for an evidence-led autonomous organisation. The landing experience uses warm archival paper, carbon ink, vermilion routes, and original architectural illustration; the app applies the same world with restrained operational density.
keyCharacteristics: Original GPT Images artwork with live HTML carrying all product language.
Warm fibrous paper, carbon planes, oxidised orange, and astronomical geometry.
Bodoni Moda for editorial display, DM Sans for interface copy, and mono only for machine metadata.
Explicit verified, unavailable, empty, and local-only states.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: Paper and illustration carry narrative surfaces; dense operational surfaces remain carbon and scan-first.

rules.name: The Truthful State Rule
rules.body: Operational status colors describe verified state only. Unconfigured systems remain neutral and explicitly labeled.

rules.name: The Illustration Truth Rule
rules.body: Generated artwork is product metaphor, never evidence of runtime activity or integration state.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with neighboring surface tones and one-pixel borders before adding any shadow.

dos: Do use original illustration to explain profiles, orchestration, and agent roles.
Do render the real product UI as proof of capability.
Do keep disconnected systems visibly offline, unconfigured, or local-only.
Do art-direct every image crop at desktop and mobile widths.
donts: Don't put live product text or runtime claims inside generated imagery.
Don't use generic neural networks, cyberpunk neon, glass, or decorative terminal streams.
Don't use stock imagery, decorative mono, or radii above 6px in app surfaces.
Don't turn status colors into large solid badges or fabricate live agent activity.
